name: Hydrogen Atom
description: Ground-state hydrogen: proton at origin, electron at 1 Bohr radius. The canonical Coulomb's Law demonstration.

name: NaCl Ion Pair
description: Sodium chloride: Na⁺ and Cl⁻ separated by the equilibrium bond length (282 pm). Ionic bond model.

name: Charge Triangle
description: Two positive charges and one negative charge in an equilateral triangle. Tests superposition and mixed attractive/repulsive interactions.
